thread:
anya: deploy-bot flagged post-deploy synthetic coverage drop in eu-west-1: synth_success_rate down to 82% at 14:03 UTC. checking.

deploy-bot: deploy completed: release/2.4.1 -> production across eu-west-1, canary=10% @1949992222. healthchecks: ok, synth probe: fail (82% success).

samir: do we have a diffsummary? maybe kv cache TTL change in this deploy?

michael: logs show repeated 502s from inference-gateway-eu when sequence > 512. snippet: ```2026-02-11T14:01:52Z ERROR gateway RequestID=abc123 502 upstream read timeout```

jen_sre: what's the impact? user-facing errors or only synthetic? any 5xx spikes in prod metrics?

anya: only synth probes and one customer heartbeat alert for a partner integration. No broad 5xx spike.

samir: suggestion: run targeted synthetic suite against canary instances with --long-seq flag and also run kv cache health check.

michael: quick check command: ```./infra/tools/synth-run --region eu-west-1 --filter smoke-longseq --count 50```

deploy-bot: scheduled synth job started by samir at 14:09 UTC. job id s-4821.

anya: results: success_rate 86/50? Wait that's 172% impossible. typo. actual: 43/50 -> 86% (failing 7). failures show `model-infer: kv-miss then timeout`.

jen_sre: ok let's pin routing in eu to previous node pool: set routing.policy=prefer:stable-2.4.0 for region eu-west-1 for 30m while we triage.

michael: command to pin: ```curl -X POST https://console/internal/routing -d '{"region":"eu-west-1","prefer":"stable-2.4.0","duration":"30m"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CI_TOKEN'```

samir: if pin helps, plan is to roll forward with fix in next patch; otherwise rollback full release.

anya: I applied the pin at 14:22 UTC. monitoring.

deploy-bot: routing change applied: prefer=stable-2.4.0 for eu-west-1 until 14:52 UTC.

anya: after pin, synth success jumped to 98% on quick run (49/50). good.

jen_sre: create follow-up ticket to investigate kv prefetch regression introduced by 2.4.1; add perf tests for long-seq. assign @samir.

samir: created ticket INF-3581 link: https://tickets/redwood/INF-3581

michael: also update release notes: note synthetic coverage gap and mitigation (regional pin). I'll add a blurb.

anya: thank you. marking thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
